item.subject: science
item.stem:
The diagram shows two spherical mirrors. Shading marks the non-reflecting back of each mirror. Light comes from the object side shown.

Bilal names each mirror from the way its reflecting surface curves.

Which statement is correct?

options.A: Mirror X is concave and Mirror Y is convex.
options.B: Mirror X is a plane mirror and Mirror Y is concave.
options.C: Both mirrors are convex because both outlines look curved.
options.D: Mirror X is convex because its shaded back looks hollow.
